children: Binance Wallet announced on X that the Hold to Earn U Leaderboard campaign is now live at @UTechStables. Users can swap and hold U to share 150,000 U starting today. The promotion period runs from 2026-09-24 00:00 to 2026-10-23 23:59 UTC. To participate, users must opt in on the activity page, activate U in DeFi Hold to Earn through Binance Wallet, and swap and hold at least 100 U in their wallet.

The announcement outlines the campaign steps and eligibility requirements for participation in the leaderboard event. Users are instructed to complete the opt-in process on the activity page before activating U in DeFi Hold to Earn through Binance Wallet. After activation, participants must maintain a minimum balance of 100 U in their wallet by swapping and holding the token. The campaign is tied to @UTechStables and is available during the stated promotion window. The reward pool totals 150,000 U, which will be shared among participants according to the campaign format described in the announcement.

title: Binance Wallet Launches Hold to Earn U Leaderboard Campaign With 150,000 U Reward Pool
